# celestial epoch

The epoch (Julian year, e.g. 2000.0) for which the coordinates are expressed. Required for proper-motion propagation; frame-relative per Principle 11.

**IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/celestialEpoch>  
**CURIE:** `gmeow:celestialEpoch`  

*datatype property* · domain `gmeow:CelestialCoordinates` · range `xsd:decimal`
